open.acknowledgement: none; fire-and-forget (Host returns null to AS2; failures arrive as gameCommand ragChatUnavailable)

hostOpenChain.preflight: health probe (<=1.5s) -> launch CFN-RAG-v*.exe --embedded -> poll health (<=20s, 500ms) -> POST /api/integration/bind (single retry)
hostOpenChain.threading: runs on ThreadPool off the synchronous panel_request transition lock; OpenPanel marshalled back to the UI thread; navigation-baseline check abandons a stale open

binding.payload: {slot_key, character?: {name: string, ...}, progress?: {tasks_finished: number[], task_chains_progress: object, tasks_active?: number[]}, scene?: {stageFlag: string, stageName: string, entrance: string, inCombat: boolean}, player?: object}
binding.semantics: idempotent; same slot_key = projection refresh; absent section clears it (replace, not merge) — refresh senders must carry every projection section they know
binding.writeState: exe memory only (never the game save)
binding.businessDecisionOwner: Host (exe memory state follows Host lifecycle)

projectionRefresh.payload: {savePath, character?, progress?, scene?, player?} — same whitelist as open initData
points: boot handshake savePath commit (bind refresh only; boot loaders read the slot overlay directly)
SaveManager.replacePlayerContext slot switch (bind refresh + _root.重新加载任务数据)
SaveManager flush ok (local SharedObject commit point)
_root.提交任务完成状态 (real task completions; UpdateTaskProgress without id does not fire it)
projectionRefresh.semantics: best-effort and idempotent; single POST, never launches the exe, exe offline silently skipped, failures log-only and never toast back to AS2

hostClose.effects: generic PanelHost close commit (web lease release, backdrop/HUD resume, pause release)

authority.chat: cfn-rag-backend exclusive on http://127.0.0.1:7077, scoped by integration bind slot_key
authority.gameState: none; phase 1 terminal holds no game-state write capability (iframe only talks to exe)
